messages.subject: rggobi for 3D viewing [was 3DScape]
parts:
Mark Grimes, hoping to plot 3D distance matrices as nodes in Cytoscape, was willing to try rggobi until Cytoscape's 3D is usable.

Since rggobi is one of the perks that implicitly comes with using RCytoscape, this small email is not -completely- off topic. But of course, feel free to ignore or delete it right away.

With a numeric matrix 'dz3' 2482 rows by 3 columns, here are instructions to load this into ggobi, assign colors by numerical range, run a '2d tour' -- the scatter plot spins in 3-space -- then brush (select) one or more points, after which you can select the corresponding data in R in the original matrix.

library (rggobi)
class (dz3) # [1] "matrix"
dim (dz3) # [1] 2482 3

gobi = ggobi (dz3)
# use some colors by level: Tools->Automatic Brushing->Constant Bin Width -> Apply -> Close
# interactively: View->2D Tour
# select one point (I chose the gray point that sits off by itself in 3-space):
# Interaction-> Brush

print (which (selected.GGobiData (gobi [1]))) # 2258
print (rownames (dz3) [which (selected.GGobiData (gobi [1]))]) # "TPM3"
print (dz3 [which (selected.GGobiData (gobi [1])),]) # 194.8816 -1350.5168 420.7481
